deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for the fall cohort (spring cohort: October 1). Late applications are not guaranteed a review.
deadline.quote: Fall cohort: application deadline is December 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need to find a faculty advisor before admission.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to secure a faculty advisor before admission? | No, there is no need to secure a faculty advisor prior to admission.

funding.value: Fellowships and assistantships are offered to top PhD applicants without a separate application; admission without funding is possible.
funding.quote: Financial support of fellowships, research assistantships and teaching assistantships are offered to top applicants with a doctoral degree objective.

also.quote: If admitted for PhD, you will automatically be considered for financial support in the form of fellowships, teaching assistantships, and research assistantships. | However, admission without financial support is possible.

entry_route.value: You need a four-year bachelor's (or equivalent) before you enrol; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have received a four-year bachelor's or equivalent degree before the term they intend to enroll into our program.

gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required by the CS Admissions Committee.

notes: CS considers TOEFL 100 (sections 22+) or IELTS 7.5 competitive, but university minimums are enough to apply. CS does not grant its own fee waivers or Discover Purdue nominations, though some university waiver programs are honoured. First-year stipend quoted for 2023-24: $23,389 (academic year).
